article.linkText: Godfrey, Fort Wayne beat UIC 78-72 in Horizon quarterfinals
article.story: FORT WAYNE, Ind. -- — Jarred Godfrey scored 22 points as Purdue Fort Wayne got past Illinois-Chicago 78-72 in the Horizon League Tourney quarterfinals on Thursday night. Jalon Pipkins added 21 points for the Mastodons. Damian Chong Qui had 14 points for Purdue Fort Wayne (21-10). Ra Kpedi added eight rebounds. Jace Carter had 16 points and nine rebounds for the Flames (14-16). Jalen Warren added 16 points.
